faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Pembroke Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 24-30 lb (11-14 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Pembroke Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD); Hip dysplasia; Degenerative myelopathy risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Pembroke Welsh Corgi at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Pembroke Welsh Corgi default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
